dex.text: A grey fluffball that survives the worst weather on Earth by standing very close to its relatives and refusing to be the one on the outside.
dex.fact: Emperor penguins huddle in tight groups through the Antarctic winter and the birds slowly shuffle round, so each takes a turn at the warm middle and a turn at the cold edge.

dex.text: The tallest, most dignified penguin there is, and dressed for a funeral and a wedding at once. Keeps its whole family warm on a single egg and an unshakeable sense of duty.
dex.fact: The emperor penguin is the largest of all penguins, standing about a metre tall, and the male keeps the egg warm on his feet through the Antarctic winter while the female feeds at sea.
